title: peucedanum macrocarpum
intro: Peucedanum macrocarpum, commonly known as Long-fruited Masterwort, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to China and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Long-fruited Masterwort include modulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
